product_updates.title: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases
product_updates.content: Meta expanded its AI coding offerings with a new agent that, it promises, can handle complex tasks with complex software.

product_updates.title: Klaviyo acquires Elias Torres’ Agency in full-circle reunion for tech founders
product_updates.content: The serial entrepreneur joins the e-commerce company as CPO to lead its AI agents.

product_updates.title: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
product_updates.content: The legendary Google executive is joined by other outgoing Google execs in a joint mission to use AI to push forward the process of scientific discovery.

product_updates.title: Shopify says AI search is driving more traffic and sales, not replacing Google
product_updates.content: Shopify says AI isn’t cannibalizing search traffic the way it has for publishers. Instead, AI-driven traffic and orders to Shopify stores tripled year over year in Q2.

product_updates.title: Hark previews its browser use agent for completing tasks
product_updates.content: Hark claims that its browser use agent is faster and cheaper than competition.

product_updates.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s Real World AI Stage features robots, automated factories, and extinct animals
product_updates.content: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.

product_updates.title: Anthropic is hiring an AI chip design team
product_updates.content: Anthropic is building a team for designing its own custom AI chips. The Claude maker said it would co-design hardware and models to help its technology run faster and more efficiently.

product_updates.title: MacPaw taps Liquid AI to offer on-device inference to devs building for its app store
product_updates.content: MacPaw is building a local version of its AI assistant Eney using Liquid AI's models.

product_updates.title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
product_updates.content: WindBorne Systems has raised a $37 million Series B round to scale its weather balloons and AI forecasts.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Thousands of servers can be backdoored by exploiting buggy motherboard controllers
technical_breakthroughs.content: Baseboard management controllers from the world's biggest manufacturers are a security mess.
